801: ਹਰਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰੇ ਰਹਿਆ ॥ ਜਲਿ ਥਲੇ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ॥ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ; ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who is present everywhere, in water and on land, and removes all the pains of beings; ever sing the praises of that Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਹੈ; ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
The Lord has made my life fruitful,
for by the Guru's grace I have begun to repeat the Name of the Lord who destroys all pain.
I have met the Guru, the Giver of release from vice,
and so the Lord has made my journey through life fruitful.
Now, joining the holy congregation, I sing songs of the Lord's praise. ॥1॥
O my mind, place your hope in the Lord's Name alone;
the Lord's Name wholly destroys attachment to Maya within.
The one who, living amid the world's work, stays untouched by attachment to Maya
stays united at the Lord's feet.
servant Nanak falls at his feet. ॥2॥1॥7॥4॥6॥7॥17॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
O Eternal One, I am ever attached to whatever my eyes can see,
but You are not seen with these eyes; how can I meet You, O imperishable Lord?
O Lord, in Your mercy set me on the true path of life;
attach me to the hem of the holy congregation. ॥1॥
This world is full of the waves of attachment to Maya; how can it be crossed?
Answer: the Guru is the ship; the Guru carries one across this ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao
Like the wind, Maya keeps swaying beings back and forth;
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ; ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
against these swings only those stay steady who ever worship the Lord.
They stay untouched by the swings of joy and sorrow,
those over whose heads the Guru himself is the protector. ॥2॥
Like a serpent, Maya has coiled itself around all beings.
Beings burn in the fire of ego as moths burn on seeing a lamp.
Though one caught in Maya make every outward adornment of garb and the like, he cannot meet the Lord.
ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ; ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
When the Lord Himself is merciful, He unites one with the Guru. ॥3॥
ਹਉ ਫਿਰਉ ਉਦਾਸੀ; ਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਦਸਾਇਆ ॥
I too wandered outside, sad, searching for the jewel of the Name,
but that diamond of the Name is priceless and is not found by outward means.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
This body is the Lord's own dwelling, and that ruby dwells within it.
ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ; ਦੇਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੪॥
When the Guru drew aside the curtain of doubt within me, I saw it within myself and was thrilled through and through. ॥4॥
The one who has tasted the relish of the Name alone knows its flavour,
but cannot tell it, like a mute who eats something sweet and is full of wonder within.
That person sees the Lord, the source of bliss, dwelling everywhere,
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੧॥
servant Nanak, the one who stays merged in the Lord, singing His praises. ॥5॥1॥
The Guru gives every comfort to the one,
the servant whom the Lord attaches to His service and devotion.
ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਜਪਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧॥
Repeating the Name of the unseen, unfathomable Lord, no obstacle of vice falls on that person's path through life. ॥1॥
Whoever sings the Lord's praises has the ground of the heart made pure.
ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever remembers the Lord's Name has sin driven out of the heart. ॥1॥ Rahao
The one whom the Lord joins to His service sees Him alone present everywhere,
ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥
the One whose glory has been great from the beginning and through all the ages.
By the Guru's grace no pain or trouble can touch that person. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ; ਲਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
The one to whom the Guru's feet feel sweet in the mind
stays safe from the obstacle of vice wherever he lives.
The Guru is pleased with that person, and he gains every comfort. ॥3॥
The Transcendent Lord God ever becomes the protector of His servants.
His servants see the Lord beside them everywhere.
Nanak: the Master has ever sustained His servants. ॥4॥2॥
O Lord, treasure of comforts, my beloved God,
802: O Master, God, Your virtues cannot be counted.
I, without a protector, have come to Your refuge.
O Lord, have mercy on me, that I may keep meditating on Your feet. ॥1॥
O Lord, have mercy and come to dwell in my mind.
ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ; ਲੀਜੈ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Attach me, without virtue, to the hem of Your robe. Rahao
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ; ਤਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੀੜ ॥
When God comes to dwell in the mind, no hardship can touch one.
Even the pain of Death cannot frighten the one who serves and worships the Lord.
Remembering the Lord's Name, all the pains of that person are removed
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ॥੨॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
God's Name alone is the support of mind and body.
Forgetting the Name, the body becomes, as it were, a heap of ashes.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਕਾਜ ॥
The one in whose mind God's Name comes to dwell has all his affairs accomplished.
Forgetting the Lord, one becomes a beggar at every door. ॥3॥
The one who comes to love the Lord's beautiful feet
forgets the whole way of life of evil thinking.
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ ॥
The Lord's Name-mantra dwells in his mind and body and lets no evil thinking come near.
ਨਾਨਕ; ਭਗਤਨ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥੪॥੩॥
Nanak: there is ever bliss in the hearts of God's devotees. ॥4॥3॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨. ਯਾਨੜੀਏ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ. ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
O my beloved Lord, in my mind is Your support alone, Your support alone.
ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਬਿਰਥੀਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O beloved Lord, You alone can protect us; all other clever schemes for protection, forgetting You, are of no use. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
The one who meets the perfect Guru stays ever in bloom.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
But only the one on whom the Lord Himself is merciful takes the Guru's refuge.
ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
The Guru, the Master, can fulfil the purpose of human life, for he holds all powers.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
Nanak: the Guru is the form of the Transcendent Lord, ever present with his servants. ॥1॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੋਇ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੀ; ਜਿਨੑ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
Hearing again and again of the glory of those who have formed deep kinship with their Lord, spiritual life springs up within me.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Those fortunate ones remember the Lord's Name, utter the Name, and their minds stay dyed in the Lord's Name alone.
ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ. ਸੇਵਾ ਮਾਗੈ; ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
O Lord, Your servant begs for the gift of serving Your servants; only by Your full grace can I do that service.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਣੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
O Master, this is Nanak's prayer: be merciful, that I may behold Your servants. ॥2॥
ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇ ਕਾਢੀਅਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
Those whose sitting and standing is ever in the company of the Guru's devoted ones may be called truly fortunate.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਮਨੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੋ ॥
In that company the pure, life-giving Name is remembered, and the light of lofty spiritual life dawns in the mind.
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣੇ ॥
In that company the pain of all one's life is cut away, and the domination of Death ends.
ਤਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
But, Nanak, the sight of such devoted ones is granted only to those who are dear to their Lord. ॥3॥
ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
O highest, boundless and infinite Master, no one can know all Your virtues.
ਗਾਵਤੇ ਉਧਰਹਿ. ਸੁਣਤੇ ਉਧਰਹਿ; ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
Those who sing Your praises escape from vice; those who hear Your praises have countless sins destroyed.
ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਉ ਤਾਰੇ; ਪਾਹਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
The Lord carries across the world-ocean those of beastly nature and great fools, and ferries over even the stone-hearted.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ. ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
Nanak, say: O Lord, Your servants stay in Your refuge and are ever a sacrifice to You. ॥4॥1॥4॥
ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ. ਤਿਆਗਿ ਰੀ ਸਖੀਏ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਓ ॥
O friend, give up drinking the insipid water of vice; ever drink the nectar of the Name, the supreme relish.
ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਚਾਖੇ. ਬੁਡਿ ਗਈ ਸਗਲੀ; ਸੁਖੀ. ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਜੀਓ ॥
Without tasting this relish, the whole world is drowning in the water of vice, yet the soul finds no comfort.
ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ. ਨ ਸਕਤਿ ਹੀ ਕਾਈ; ਸਾਧਾ ਦਾਸੀ ਥੀਓ ॥
No other support, greatness or strength can bring one the nectar of the Name; O friend, become the servant of the Guru's devoted ones.
803: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੇ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕੀਓ ॥੧॥
Nanak: those are honoured at the Lord's door whom the beloved Lord Himself has made honoured. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਚਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਖੀਏ; ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
O friend, this Maya is a castle in the air, a means of setting the mind wandering, a mirage, a tree's shade.
ਚੰਚਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਚਾਲਤੀ ਸਖੀਏ; ਅੰਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਵਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Never staying in one place, this fickle Maya goes with no one; in the end it deserts all.
ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗਣ ਅਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ; ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਖੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
O friend, enjoying the world's things with relish and staying intoxicated with its forms and flavours, no spiritual bliss is found in their company.
ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸਖੀਏ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Nanak, say: O friend, blessed, blessed are the Lord's devotees who have ever remembered the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
ਜਾਇ ਬਸਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੀ ਸਖੀਏ; ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
O fortunate friend, go and dwell in the holy congregation; one should ever stay in the company of the Guru's devoted ones.
ਤਹ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਭੂਖ. ਨ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Dwelling there, neither the world's sorrows nor craving for Maya nor any disease can take hold; there, fix your attention on God's beautiful feet.
ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣੁ. ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Staying in the holy congregation, the round of birth and death does not touch one and the mind stays steady; so stay ever in God's refuge.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
Nanak: by the blessing of the holy congregation neither lack of love for God nor attachment to Maya can take hold; there one can ever remember the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਰਤੜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
O beloved Lord, those whose minds You have strung to Your feet with Your gracious glance stay ever dyed in poise and love.
ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
O Beloved, meeting Your feet their hearts fill with bliss, and singing Your praises they stay in joy.
ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
The companions of the congregation who stay dyed in the Lord's love have every wish of mind and body fulfilled by Him.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਅਚਰਜੁ ਅਚਰਜ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
Nanak: their elevated souls so meet the wondrous Lord that the state cannot be described. ॥4॥2॥5॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
This whole expanse of the world is the many forms of the One Lord.
Pervading all beings, the Lord Himself carries on the world's trade and dealings. ॥1॥
But only a rare person gains this understanding:
ਜਤ ਜਤ ਜਾਈਐ; ਤਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
wherever one goes in the world, the Lord alone is seen. ॥1॥ Rahao
All the many plays seen in the world are of the Lord, ever of one colour and untouched by Maya's three qualities.
He Himself is the water and Himself the waves; as water and its waves are one, so the world's many forms have come from the Lord. ॥2॥
The Lord Himself is the temple, Himself the worship,
ਆਪ ਹੀ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ; ਆਪ ਹੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
Himself the deity in the temple, and Himself its priest. ॥3॥
The Lord Himself is the yogi and Himself the means of yoga.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
Though pervading all beings, Nanak's Lord is ever free and untouched. ॥4॥1॥6॥
The Lord Himself creates all beings and Himself supports them.
Pervading all, the Lord Himself has all work done by beings, yet takes no blame for it upon Himself. ॥1॥
Pervading every being, the Lord Himself speaks His word and Himself acts on it.
ਆਪਨ ਬਿਭਉ; ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He Himself bears His own splendour, which no one else could endure. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮਸਟਿ; ਆਪ ਹੀ ਬੁਲਨਾ ॥
He is in everyone: in the one keeping silence He Himself is silent, and in the one who speaks He Himself speaks.
ਆਪ ਹੀ ਅਛਲੁ; ਨ ਜਾਈ ਛਲਨਾ ॥੨॥
Seated in some, the Lord Himself is beyond Maya's sway, and Maya cannot deceive Him. ॥2॥
The Lord Himself lies hidden in all beings, and Himself is plainly seen as the creation.
ਆਪ ਹੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ; ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਨਾ ॥੩॥
The Lord Himself dwells in every body, and dwelling in each, He Himself stays untouched. ॥3॥
The Lord Himself is unseen, and Himself is joined with the creation He made.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਚਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੭॥
Nanak says: all the wonders seen in the world are God's own. ॥4॥2॥7॥
The one who shows the true path of life to those straying from it,
such a Guru is found only by great fortune. ॥1॥
O my mind, attentively remember the Lord's Name.
ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only the one in whose heart the dear Guru's feet dwell can remember the Name; so, O mind, take the Guru's support. ॥1॥ Rahao
804: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ; ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
A person's mind stays ever caught in lust, anger, greed and attachment.
But when he came to the Guru's refuge, the Guru cut all these bonds and freed him from these vices. ॥2॥
ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤ; ਜਨਮਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਮੂਆ ॥
Going through pain and pleasure, a person now dies and now comes alive again, shrinking in pain and breathing easy in pleasure.
When such a person came to the Guru's refuge, the Guru gave him the shelter of the Lord's beautiful feet. ॥3॥
The world is drowning in the ocean of the fire of craving.
Nanak: whoever took the Guru's refuge, the Guru took by the arm and carried across. ॥4॥3॥8॥
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ; ਅਰਪਉ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
If some devoted one would give me the counsel that brings remembrance, I would offer my body, mind and wealth, everything.
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥
What is that good teaching by which the Lord's Name can be remembered? ॥1॥
O Lord, with hope I have come to Your door to beg for the gift of Your Name.
ਤੁਮੑ ਪੇਖਤ; ਸੋਭਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਆਗਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Beholding You, joy springs up in the courtyard of my heart. ॥1॥ Rahao
Setting many methods before me, I reflect deeply on how to save this mind from vice,
and in the end understand that only in the company of the Guru's devoted ones can I save it. ॥2॥
The Lord is not met by any intellect, wisdom, meditation or cleverness.
He is met only when He Himself unites a being with Himself. ॥3॥
The one whose eyes, through His sight, are sated of craving for Maya,
Nanak says, blessed is the coming into the world of that person who has beheld the Lord. ॥4॥4॥9॥
ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Mother, father, son and Maya: none of these can be a lasting companion or help when pain strikes.
Dwelling in the Guru's company, all pain and trouble can be removed. ॥1॥
ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
The Lord who Himself pervades all beings,
ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
keep repeating His Name with the tongue, and no pain can take hold. ॥1॥ Rahao
The world is caught in the thirst, hunger and burning of Maya.
ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੨॥
Those who praise the Lord have their hearts cooled. ॥2॥
Even with millions of efforts, contentment with Maya's craving is not found.
Singing the Lord's praises, the mind is satisfied. ॥3॥
O Lord, Knower of every heart, give me the gift of Your devotion;
O Master, this is the prayer of Nanak, Your servant. ॥4॥5॥10॥
The perfect Guru is found only by great good fortune.
Only by meeting the Guru can the Lord's Name be remembered. ॥1॥
O Transcendent Lord God, I have come to Your refuge; unite me with the Guru.
ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ; ਭਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Enshrine the Guru's feet in your heart; the Guru cuts away all sins. ॥1॥ Rahao
Without the Guru's refuge all other deeds are mere show.
Only by joining the Guru's company is one carried across the world-ocean. ॥2॥
I have reflected on all the Simritis, Shastras and Vedas:
in the Guru's refuge the Lord's Name alone should be remembered, for through it the Guru carries one across. ॥3॥
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
O Lord, have mercy on Your servant Nanak,
that I may receive the dust of the Guru's feet; by the Guru's grace one crosses the world-ocean. ॥4॥6॥11॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
Those fortunate ones who reflected on the Guru's Word in their hearts
had all their wishes fulfilled and all their hopes accomplished. ॥1॥
ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ, ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
The faces of those saints shone in this world and the next,
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
to whom the Lord in His mercy gave His Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ; ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
Those fortunate ones whom the Lord took by the hand and drew out of the dark well of attachment to Maya
had their great glory spread through the whole world. ॥2॥
Those people were raised from low to high, and those once empty of virtues were filled with them,
who began to repeat the life-giving Name, the supreme relish. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਪਾਪ ਜਲਿ ਖੀਨਾ ॥
Their minds and bodies became pure, and all their sins were burnt to ash,
Nanak says, those with whom God was pleased. ॥4॥7॥12॥
O friend, joined to the Lord, all the wishes of the mind are fulfilled;
805: so fix your mind on the Lord's lotus feet. ॥1॥
I am a sacrifice to those who remember God's Name.
ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Singing the Lord's praises again and again, the burning of craving for Maya is quenched. ॥1॥ Rahao
The lives of those fortunate ones become fruitful
whose attention, in the Guru's company, is joined to the Lord. ॥2॥
ਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
Joining attention to the Lord, one gains honour in this world and the next and the wealth of the comfort and bliss of spiritual poise.
Do not forget the Name of the Lord of supreme bliss even for the blink of an eye; through the Name the intellect is raised high. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ; ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
O Lord, my mind has a great thirst for Your sight; fulfil this longing.
Nanak prays: O Lord, I have come to Your refuge. ॥4॥8॥13॥
Me, without virtue, empty of all virtues,
the Lord in His mercy has made His own servant. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
The Lord, the Sustainer, has made my mind and body beautiful.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In His mercy the Lord has come to dwell in my heart-home. ॥1॥ Rahao
O Lord, Lover of devotion, Remover of all fears,
now that You dwell in my heart-home, by Your grace I have crossed the world-ocean. ॥2॥
ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ; ਬੇਦਿ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥
The Lord of whom the Vedas and every scripture have written that He purifies even sinners,
that Transcendent Lord I have seen with my own eyes, dwelling everywhere. ॥3॥
The one in whose heart the Lord is revealed through dwelling in the Guru's company,
servant Nanak, has all his pains removed. ॥4॥9॥14॥
O Lord, no one by his own wisdom knows how to serve and worship You;
O imperishable, unseen, unfathomable Lord, this skill comes only by Your grace. ॥1॥
O profound Lord, great of heart, You are the Master of infinite virtues.
O my Master God, lofty are the spiritual realms in which You dwell.
O my Lord, You are beyond the beyond. ॥1॥ Rahao
O Lord, there is none like You but You alone.
You alone know how You are to be worshipped. ॥2॥
By their own strength beings cannot worship the Lord in the least.
ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਵੈ; ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
Only the one to whom the Lord gives it receives the gift of the Name. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Nanak says: the person who becomes dear to the Lord
ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੫॥
alone has attained union with the Lord, the treasure of virtues. ॥4॥10॥15॥
ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ; ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
O fool, the Lord who saved you in your mother's womb, giving you His hand,
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥੧॥
forgetting the bliss of His Name, you are tasting the fruit of Maya. ॥1॥
O fool, give up all the entanglements of attachment and remember the Lord of the universe.
ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਮੂੜੇ; ਤਬ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਬੇਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When Death's messenger comes and makes his deadly attack, the body perishes in agony. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ; ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ॥
You regard this body, mind and wealth as your own,
but you have not remembered even for a moment the Lord who made them. ॥2॥
You have fallen into the pitch-dark well of great attachment;
behind the curtain of attachment to Maya you have forgotten the Lord. ॥3॥
The one who by great fortune began to sing the song of the Lord's praise,
Nanak, attained union with the Lord in the company of the saints. ॥4॥11॥16॥
like all these, the Transcendent Lord alone has become Nanak's helper. ॥1॥
In the refuge of that Guru many comforts and joys of spiritual poise are found,
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਣਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ. ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਗਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Guru who is full of all virtues, whose Bani is full of spiritual bliss, whose countless virtues cannot be counted. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Lord Himself arranges the accomplishing of all the affairs of the one in His refuge;
repeating that Lord's Name, all the mind's wishes are fulfilled. ॥2॥
ਅਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
The Lord Himself is the Giver of the four renowned things: wealth, righteousness, desire and liberation.
806: Remembering the Creator again and again, the effort of remembrance bears fruit. ॥3॥
Nanak has enjoyed spiritual bliss in the Guru's company;
by the Guru's grace the Lord has come to dwell in Nanak's heart; the perfect Guru has brought Him and settled Him there. ॥4॥12॥17॥
Taking the refuge of the perfect Guru, the Lord, Master of all treasures, is met. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ. ਨਰ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
In the Guru's refuge, repeating the Lord's Name, people find spiritual life.
But those cut off from the Lord bring on spiritual death and suffer. ॥1॥
For the one who repeats the Name in the Guru's refuge, the Lord's Name becomes a protector everywhere.
The poor one cut off from the Lord may babble on in slander, but can do him no harm. ॥2॥
Many who slander the one who remembers the Name only burn up themselves.
The noose of spiritual death lies on their necks and feet, and spiritual death rides upon their heads. ॥3॥
Nanak, say: those who repeat the Lord's Name,
even Death cannot come near them. ॥4॥13॥18॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
What are the auspicious moments when I may meet my Lord?
ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਿਮਖ; ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥
Every moment is such a moment: repeating the Lord's Name each moment, each blink of an eye, union with Him comes. ॥1॥
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
What is that wisdom by which I may ever meditate on God's beautiful feet?
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
What is that good understanding by which I may meet my Beloved? ॥1॥ Rahao
Remembrance comes only by the Lord's own grace; so pray: O my Lord, show me such mercy,
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸਰੁ; ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੯॥
O Lord, that I, Nanak, may never forget Your Name. ॥2॥1॥19॥
The one who, by the Guru's grace, began to meditate on God's beautiful feet in the heart
had all diseases depart and gained every comfort. ॥1॥
The one to whom the Guru gave the gift of the Lord's Name, the Guru also cut away all his suffering.
That person's life became fruitful and was accepted in this world and the next. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Bani in praise of God, Master of countless virtues, gives spiritual life.
Nanak says: the one in deep kinship with God gains spiritual life by remembering His virtues again and again. ॥2॥2॥20॥
The one in whose heart the perfect Guru, the True Guru, spread coolness with the gift of the Lord's Name,
ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ; ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
had every comfort arise within, as if all instruments began to play within unceasingly. ॥1॥ Rahao
Fever, sin and torment were destroyed;
remembering the Lord's Name, all sins were driven away. ॥1॥
O my senses, made beautiful by the Name, now join together in the holy congregation and bring forth spiritual bliss within.
Guru Nanak has kept my honour, saving me from fever, sin and anguish. ॥2॥3॥21॥
ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ; ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
Caught in the world-ocean, a being stays intoxicated with possessiveness, attachment and deceit; bound in the grip of attachment to Maya, he becomes dreadful in his ways.
ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਛਿਜਤ. ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਰਤ ਅਉਧ; ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥਾ. ਜਮ ਕੈ ਜਾਲ ॥੧॥
Committing vices day after day, his life wastes away, and he stays caught in Death's noose and net. ॥1॥
O God, Merciful to the meek, I have come to Your refuge.
ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ; ਉਧਰਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This world-ocean is vast and very hard to cross; O God, keep me in the Guru's company and give me the dust of the Guru's feet, and save me from drowning. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਾਲ ॥
O God, Giver of all comforts, all-powerful Master, the life and body beings have are all capital given by You.
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੨॥
O Transcendent Lord, Nanak's God, ever merciful, cut the bonds of wandering of beings straying in Maya. ॥2॥4॥22॥
ਸਗਲ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ; ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿਆ ॥
Be sure of this: the Lord ever remembers His age-old nature of loving His devotees and gives them every comfort and bliss.
ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਹੋਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ; ਬਿਗਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
He is ever merciful to His saints, and their whole family, all their senses too, stays in bliss. ॥1॥
People were urging the worship of the goddess and the like, but see: my True Guru Himself has accomplished this task of healing Hargobind of smallpox.
807: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ; ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru Himself has lengthened Hargobind's life and has thought of giving him comfort, joy and bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਵਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਏ; ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
The Lord, by whose grace all forests, all vegetation and all three worlds stay green, gives support to all beings.
ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ; ਪੂਰਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੩॥
Nanak: whoever takes the Lord's shelter obtains the fruits the mind desires, and the Lord fulfils all his wishes; so take the support of that Lord alone. ॥2॥5॥23॥
The one on whom the Guru is merciful,
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਕਾਟੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
remembering the Lord's Name again and again, cuts away the net of spiritual death. ॥1॥ Rahao
Dwelling in the Guru's company, remember the Sustainer of the world.
Singing His praises again and again, Death's net is broken. ॥1॥
The Lord Himself, in the form of the Guru, Himself saves beings from Death's net.
So Nanak ever begs for the dust of the Guru's feet. ॥2॥6॥24॥
ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
Ever irrigate your mind with the nectar of the Lord's Name,
and at all times praise the Lord and sing His virtues. ॥1॥
O my mind, form such a love with the Lord
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that at all hours you know God to be near you. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਾਗ ॥
Nanak says: the one whose good fortune awakens
ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੫॥
has his mind absorbed in the Lord's feet. ॥2॥7॥25॥
Only the one whose disease God Himself took away, by giving the Name through the Guru, has been rid of it.
ਨੀਦ ਪਈ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Name that person finds spiritual peace, as if falling into restful sleep, and reaches the home of comfort and poise. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਵਹੁ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
O my brother, the Lord's Name is the food of the soul; eat this food to your fill.
Meditate in your heart on the Lord's Name, which gives spiritual life. ॥1॥
Nanak, say: stay in the refuge of the perfect Guru,
ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੬॥
who helps those in his refuge and has always kept the honour of his Name. ॥2॥8॥26॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Lord has made the Guru's homes, the holy congregation, everlasting; they are for ever the places where union with Him can be had. Rahao
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਇਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਨ ਕੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਮਾਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
Whoever slanders these homes, scorning the holy congregation, the Creator has already struck with spiritual death. ॥1॥
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ; ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੰਡ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੭॥
Nanak: only through the holy congregation does one come to the refuge of the Lord whose command is unshakeable and infinite. ॥2॥9॥27॥
ਤਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਸਗਲੇ ਗਏ; ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
The one who enjoys the bliss of remembering the Name has all fevers, torments and diseases destroyed.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਤੂ ਬਖਸਿਆ; ਸੰਤਨ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Transcendent Lord has shown you grace; so enjoy the bliss of the saints, the bliss of remembering the Name. Rahao
ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੰਡਲੀ; ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਰੋਗ ॥
If you keep taking this medicine of remembrance, every comfort will be your companion, and your mind and body will stay free of disease.
ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ; ਇਹ ਅਵਖਦ ਜੋਗ ॥੧॥
Ever sing the Lord's praises; this is the fitting medicine for fever, anguish and disease. ॥1॥
ਆਇ ਬਸਹੁ ਘਰ ਦੇਸ ਮਹਿ; ਇਹ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
The days of human life are the good chance for union with the Lord; while you have this birth, give up wandering outside and come to dwell in the home of your own heart.
ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ; ਲਹਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਓਗ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੮॥
Nanak, say: the one on whom God is well pleased has all separations from Him removed. ॥2॥10॥28॥
ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਚਾਲਹੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
The saints ever hold this certainty in their minds: the entanglements of Maya go with no one.
ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ; ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਖਿਆਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Even kings and emperors rise and depart, leaving them behind; so the saints ever remember the Lord's Name. Rahao
ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਨਸਨਾ; ਇਹ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਢਾਲ ॥
The one caught in Maya, ever thinking only "may I become great", surely meets spiritual death; this is the rule from the Lord's court.
ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥੧॥
This is the dreadful result of attachment to Maya: those in its grip are born and die in many species. ॥1॥
ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਹਹਿ; ਨਿਤ ਜਪਹਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
The Guru's devoted ones praise the eternal Lord and ever repeat the Name of the Sustainer of the world.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਲ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੯॥
Nanak: dyed deep in the Lord's love and remembering His Name again and again, the saints cross the ocean of attachment to Maya. ॥2॥11॥29॥
ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੂਖ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨ ॥
To the one on whom the Guru is merciful, the perfect Guru has given all the comfort and bliss of steady absorption in spiritual poise.
ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਚੀਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
God becomes his helper and stays ever with him, and he keeps reflecting on God's life-giving virtues. Rahao
808: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ; ਲੋਚਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
That person is acclaimed everywhere in the world, and all beings long for his sight,
ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥
the one with whom the Guru and God are well pleased; no obstacle arises on his path of life. ॥1॥
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ. ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਦਾਸ ॥
The one whose side the merciful Lord takes, all beings become his servants.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੦॥
Nanak: staying at the Guru's feet, one ever receives honour. ॥2॥12॥30॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ; ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
The Lord has made this world such that death rules over it; it is like houses built of sand.
ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ. ਨ ਲਾਗਈ; ਜਿਉ ਕਾਗਦ ਬੂੰਦਾਰ ॥੧॥
As paper melts at once in drops of rain, so these houses take no time to perish. ॥1॥
ਸੁਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨਸਾ. ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ; ਸਤਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
O thoughts of my mind, O my wandering mind, listen carefully; reflect and see this truth:
ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋਗੀ; ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
adepts, seekers, householders and yogis all leave home and everything behind when death comes. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜੈਸਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਿ ਕਾ; ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
This world is just like a dream seen in sleep at night.
ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਨਸੀਐ; ਕਿਆ ਲਗਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
O fool, all that is seen is perishable; why do you form attachment to it? ॥2॥
ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਹੈ; ਦੇਖੁ ਨੈਨ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
O fool, open your eyes and look: where have those brothers and friends of yours gone?
ਇਕਿ ਚਾਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਾਲਸਹਿ; ਸਭਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
Each in turn, some have gone and some will go; all beings are leaving in their turn. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
Those who took the support of the perfect Guru stay fixed at the Lord's door, at His feet, instead of being attached to the visible world.
ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
Servant Nanak is the Lord's servant and prays at His door: O Lord, I have come to Your refuge; keep my honour. ॥4॥1॥31॥
Compared with union with the Lord, I am ready to throw into the fire all the honours people give me.
ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਨਾ; ਤੇ ਬੋਲ ਕਰਾਗਉ ॥੧॥
Instead of flattering the world's people, I will speak only those words through which my beloved Lord may meet me. ॥1॥
ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਇ; ਤਉ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਗਉ ॥
Only when the Lord is merciful to me can I take to His devotion.
ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ; ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ. ਇਹ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This mind stays entangled in desires for worldly things; only in the Guru's refuge can I give them up. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਅਤਿ ਘਨੀ; ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਮਾਗਉ ॥
At the Lord's door I will pray with great humility and offer up even my life.
ਅਰਥ ਆਨ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਰਿਆ; ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਿਮਖ ਸੋਹਾਗਉ ॥੨॥
For the bliss of a single moment's union with the Beloved I will sacrifice all the world's things. ॥2॥
ਪੰਚ. ਸੰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ; ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਗਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace the company of the five, lust and the rest, has ended within me, and envy and attachment are gone.
ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਆ; ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਜਾਗਉ ॥੩॥
The light of true living has shone in my heart; now I stay awake day and night against their attacks. ॥3॥
ਸਰਣਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਆਇਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਉ ॥
The one on whose forehead good fortune awakens takes the Guru's refuge like a wedded bride.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਗਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
Nanak says: by the Guru's grace that person has attained union with God, and freed from lust and the rest, his mind and body are cooled. ॥4॥2॥32॥
ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਾ; ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
Only the one whose great fortune awakens has his mind dyed in the deep red of the Lord's love.
ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ. ਦਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
This colour is such that the filth of vice never soils it and no stain of vice touches it. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਈਆ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ॥
The one who has found God, the Giver of all comforts, and met Him abiding in bliss and love,
ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਭੀਤਰੇ; ਛੋਡਿਆ. ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
stays merged within in spiritual poise and so relishes it that he cannot leave it. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ. ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪਈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
That spiritual height knows no old age and no death, and no pain can touch him again.
ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਘਾਨਿਆ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਅਮਰੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
The one to whom the Guru has given unshakeable spiritual life drinks the life-giving Name-water and is sated of hunger for Maya. ॥2॥
ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
Only the one who has tasted it knows its worth; the Lord's Name cannot be had in exchange for any worldly thing.
ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਈਐ; ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥੩॥
The worth of the Lord's Name cannot be told; what can I say with my mouth? ॥3॥
ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
O Transcendent Lord, Your sight fulfils the purpose of human life, and the Bani of Your praise is a treasure of virtues.
809: ਪਾਵਉ ਧੂਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੩॥
Nanak, say: O Lord, be merciful, that I may receive the dust of Your servant's feet; I am a sacrifice to Your servant. ॥4॥3॥33॥
ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
O God, in Your mercy keep me in Your own refuge.
ਸੇਵਾ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਜਾਨਊ; ਨੀਚੁ ਮੂਰਖਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
I am of low life and foolish; I have no skill or sense to serve and worship You. ॥1॥
ਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਊਪਰੇ; ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
O my Beloved, my dear one, I rely on You alone, on Your grace.
ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸਦ ਭੂਲਤੇ; ਤੁਮੑ ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
We beings ever sin and err; You ever forgive us. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਮ ਅਵਗਨ ਕਰਹ ਅਸੰਖ ਨੀਤਿ; ਤੁਮੑ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
O Lord, we commit countless faults every day, yet You give countless gifts to us, the unworthy.
ਦਾਸੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਆਗਿ; ਏ ਕਰਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
O Lord, our daily deeds are these: forgetting You, we stay in the company of Your handmaid, Maya. ॥2॥
ਤੁਮੑ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ. ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ; ਹਮ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਨਾਰੇ ॥
O Lord, we are ungrateful, yet in Your mercy You give us everything.
ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨ ਸਿਉ; ਨਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਖਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
O Master, we do not keep You in our minds but ever cling to the gifts You give. ॥3॥
ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ. ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ; ਭਵ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
O Destroyer of the round of births, nothing in the world can be beyond Your command; keep us too on the true path of life.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਰ; ਲੇਹੁ ਮੁਗਧ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੪॥
Nanak says: O merciful Guru, we have come to your refuge; keep saving us fools from faults and errors. ॥4॥4॥34॥
ਦੋਸੁ. ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਜੀਐ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
O my mind, blame no one else for the pain that comes from your own errors; to escape it, remember your own Lord,
ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਨਾ; ਮਨ ਸੋਈ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
for serving and worshipping Him brings great comfort; sing His praises alone. ॥1॥
O beloved Lord, to whom but You should one pray for release from these pains?
ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸਭ ਅਵਗਨ ਹਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O my Master, You are ever the home of mercy; all the faults that bring us pain are ours. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਿਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
O Lord, as You keep me, so I live; against Your will I have no power.
ਨੀਧਰਿਆ. ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀਆ; ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
O Lord, You are the support of the supportless; I have only Your Name to lean on. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ; ਮਨਿ ਲੇਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
O Lord, the one who accepts whatever You do as being for his good is saved from the blows of pain.
ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ; ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੩॥
O Lord, all the things of the world are made by You, and all creation runs within Your order. ॥3॥
ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ; ਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
O Lord, Master, if it pleases You, may I serve and worship You and wash Your feet, that is, giving up ego, stay fallen at Your door.
ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੫॥
O Lord, be kind and merciful, that by Your grace Nanak may keep singing Your praises. ॥4॥5॥35॥
ਮਿਰਤੁ ਹਸੈ. ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰੇ; ਪਸੂਆ. ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Death stands over every head laughing that the fool, caught in Maya, never thinks of his death; but the beastly person does not understand.
ਬਾਦ ਸਾਦ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ; ਮਰਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੧॥
Caught in quarrels, tastes and pride, a person does not see death. ॥1॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਆਪਨਾ; ਕਾਹੇ ਫਿਰਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
O unfortunate one, why do you wander? Stay in your Guru's refuge.
ਦੇਖਿ ਕਸੁੰਭਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ; ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Why do you go astray at the sight of the bright safflower of alluring Maya? ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਪ. ਦਰਬੁ ਕੀਆ; ਵਰਤਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
All life long a person gathers wealth for his own use by committing sin after sin,
ਮਾਟੀ ਸਿਉ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲੀ; ਨਾਗਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
but when death comes the clay of his body mixes with the earth and the soul leaves empty-handed. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਐ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰੈ; ਤੇ ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧੀ ॥
Those relatives for whom one labours to gather wealth cannot stand by him to the end and so become his enemies and opponents.
ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ. ਭਜਿ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ; ਕਾਹੇ ਜਲਹੁ ਕਰੋਧੀ ॥੩॥
Why do you burn in anger, making enemies of others for their sake? At the end they will desert you. ॥3॥
ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Only the one on whose forehead fortune awakens becomes the dust of the feet of the Lord's devotees.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੬॥
Nanak says: in the Guru's refuge the bonds of attachment to Maya are broken. ॥4॥6॥36॥
ਪਿੰਗੁਲ. ਪਰਬਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ; ਖਲ. ਚਤੁਰ ਬਕੀਤਾ ॥
O friend, by the Guru's grace the lame cross mountains and the utterly foolish become wise speakers;
ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੂਝਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥੧॥
meeting the Guru, people become pure of life, and the blind gain understanding of the three worlds. ॥1॥
ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਕੀ; ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
O my friend, listen carefully to the glory of the Guru's company.
ਮੈਲੁ ਖੋਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਹਰੇ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever sits daily in the Guru's company has his mind made pure, the filth of vice removed, and millions of sins destroyed. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ; ਕੀਟਿ ਹਸਤੀ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
The Lord's devotion, practised in the holy congregation, has such wondrous power that the ant of humility has conquered the elephant of pride.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਪਨੋ; ਤਿਸੁ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
Whoever the Lord, pleased with devotion, has made His own, He has given the gift of fearlessness. ॥2॥
ਸਿੰਘੁ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ; ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਮੇਰੁ ਦਿਖੀਤਾ ॥
By the Guru's company the lion of pride becomes the cat of humility, and the straw of a humble nature is seen as mighty Mount Meru.
810: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਤੇ. ਦਮ ਆਢ ਕਉ; ਤੇ ਗਨੀ ਧਨੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
Those who once toiled for half a shell become rich and wealthy, free of dependence on Maya. ॥3॥
ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਉ; ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
Which glories of the Lord's Name, found in the holy congregation, can I tell? The Lord's Name is the master of infinite virtues.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ, ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਰਸ ਰੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੩੭॥
Nanak, pray: O Lord, I am a slave at Your door; be merciful and bless me with Your Name. ॥4॥7॥37॥
ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਬਾਦ ਨੀਤ; ਲੋਭ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
Strayed from the Lord's Name, a person, relying on the intellect of pride, ever speaks harsh words of challenge to others and stays caught in greed and the tastes of the tongue;
ਲਪਟਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ; ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆਦਿ ॥੧॥
caught in attachment to home and in deceit, he stays pierced by attachment to perishable Maya. ॥1॥
ਐਸੀ ਪੇਖੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
By the Guru's grace I have seen with my own eyes that such is the state of the world's things:
ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨਾ; ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ. ਬਾਦਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
kingdoms, lands, wealth and youth are all in vain without the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
Beautiful things, incense and perfumes, clothes and fine foods,
ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪਿਸਟ ਤਨ; ਹੋਏ ਦੁਰਗਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
touching the body of a great sinner, all become foul-smelling. ॥2॥
ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਭਇਆ; ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗਨ ਦੇਹਾਦਿ ॥
Wandering through countless species a being becomes human, and even this body perishes in a moment; yet in it he stays strayed from the Lord's Name.
ਇਹ ਅਉਸਰ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਿਆ; ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਦਿ ॥੩॥
Missing this opportunity, the being wanders again through many species. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
Nanak: those who, by God's grace, met the Guru repeated the Name of the wondrous Lord,
ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨੰਦ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥੪॥੮॥੩੮॥
and in their hearts the music of the comfort and bliss of spiritual poise began to sound for ever. ॥4॥8॥38॥
ਚਰਨ ਭਏ ਸੰਤ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ; ਤਰੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜੇਤ ॥
The Guru's feet became the ship by which that person crossed the world-ocean.
ਮਾਰਗ ਪਾਏ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਦਸੇ ਭੇਤ ॥੧॥
The one to whom the Guru told the secret of remembering the Lord's Name found the true path of life in the wilderness that leads to vice. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੇਤ ॥
Ever, at all times, keep love for the Lord's Name.
ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Rising, sitting and sleeping, at all times remember the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਆਗੈ ਭਗੇ; ਜਬ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਤ ॥
When a person settles in the holy congregation, the five thieves, lust and the rest, flee before him.
ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਘਣੋ ਲਾਭੁ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤ ॥੨॥
His whole capital of spiritual life is saved from plunder, he earns great profit in this trade of the Name, and goes to the world beyond with honour. ॥2॥
ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਣੁ. ਮਿਟੀ ਚਿੰਤ; ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਲੇਤ ॥
Against the vices his heart's seat becomes unshakeable, every worry is wiped away, and he does not waver before the vices.
ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਨੇਤ ॥੩॥
Beholding the Lord everywhere with his eyes, by the blessing of the holy congregation, his wandering ends. ॥3॥
ਗੁਣ ਗਭੀਰ ਗੁਨ ਨਾਇਕਾ; ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤ ॥
The Lord is the fathomless ocean of virtues, the treasure of virtues; all His virtues cannot be described.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰੇਤ ॥੪॥੯॥੩੯॥
Nanak: the one who, dwelling in the holy congregation, drinks the life-giving water of the Lord's Name attains union with Him. ॥4॥9॥39॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨਾ; ਤੇਤੋ ਬਿਰਥਾਰੀ ॥
All the life spent without meeting the Guru goes to waste.
ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਭਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਿਟੇ; ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
Joining the Guru's company, all wandering is wiped away, and by his grace we attain the highest spiritual state. ॥1॥
ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਮੋਹਿ; ਉਆ ਦਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the day when my Guru met me.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਜੀਅਰਾ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Now again and again I offer my body, my mind and my dear life to my Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਏਤ ਛਡਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੇ; ਇਤਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾਰੀ ॥
By his grace the Guru has freed me from so much possessiveness and made humility so firm in my heart
ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨ. ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ; ਬਿਨਸੀ ਅਪਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
that my mind has become the dust of everyone's feet, and the constant thought of my own interest is gone. ॥2॥
ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਪਰ ਦੂਖਨਾ; ਏ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
The Guru has burnt away in an instant the thought of slandering others and the wish to see harm come to them.
ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪੇਖੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Kindness to others, compassion for the needy, and seeing the Lord ever near me now dwell within me at all times. ॥3॥
ਤਨ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ; ਅਬ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
Since I met the Guru, by his grace my mind and body have become calm and free of the world's attachments and bonds.
ਹੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ; ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੦॥
Nanak, say: now my longing, my awareness and my life are absorbed in the sight of the Lord; His sight alone is my wealth. ॥4॥10॥40॥
ਟਹਲ ਕਰਉ. ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ; ਪਗ ਝਾਰਉ ਬਾਲ ॥
O Lord, be merciful, that I may serve Your servant and dust his feet with my hair.
ਮਸਤਕੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਭੇਟ ਦੇਉ; ਗੁਨ ਸੁਨਉ ਰਸਾਲ ॥੧॥
May I offer my head to Your servant and keep hearing from him Your praises full of nectar. ॥1॥
ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਓ; ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
O merciful Lord, meet me; meeting You, my mind receives spiritual life.
ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ; ਚਿਤਵਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, home of mercy, remembering Your virtues, there is bliss in my mind day and night. ॥1॥ Rahao
